forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.sent: If {email} is registered, we've sent you a link to reset your password. Check your inbox (and your spam folder). The link expires in 1 hour.
forgotPassword.intro: Enter your account email and we'll send you a link to create a new password.

resetPassword.title: Reset password
resetPassword.missingToken: The reset token is missing. Open the link from the email we sent you, or <link>request a new one</link>.
resetPassword.done: Your password has been changed. You can now sign in with it.

verify.successBody: Your account is now active. You can post jobs and use Tu Chamba as usual.
verify.errorHint: Sign in and request a new link from the notice in your account.

google.unavailable: Google sign-in isn't available yet. Please use your email and password.
